crossRefs.note: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in…
The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

translations.web: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
translations.bsb: He pierced my kidneys with His arrows.
translations.kjv: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
translations.asv: He hath caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my reins.
